d: Used to solve problems involving arrays containing numbers in a given range [1, N] or [0, N]. Sorts in O(n) time and O(1) space.
c: Find All Numbers Disappeared in an Array

p: Cyclic Sort is the optimal pattern when you are given an array containing numbers in a given range [1, N]. It sorts the array in O(N) time without using any extra space by placing each number at its correct index (`num - 1`).

def cyclicSort(nums):
  i = 0
  while i < len(nums):
    j = nums[i] - 1
    if 0 <= j < len(nums) and nums[i] != nums[j]:
      nums[i], nums[j] = nums[j], nums[i]
    else:
      i += 1
  return nums
Time: O(N) since each element is swapped to its correct place at most once. Space: O(1).

[3, 1, 5, 4, 2]
Swap 3 to idx 2 -> [5, 1, 3, 4, 2]
Swap 5 to idx 4 -> [2, 1, 3, 4, 5]
Swap 2 to idx 1 -> [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] (Sorted in O(N))
